title: The Little Match Girl (The Vision of Peace)
summary: Barefoot in the New Year's Eve snowfall, the little match seller crouched between cold brick walls, her trembling fingers numbed by the bitter Scandinavian frost....
full_text:
Barefoot in the New Year's Eve snowfall, the little match seller crouched between cold brick walls, her trembling fingers numbed by the bitter Scandinavian frost.

Each match struck against the rough brick awakened an incandescent vision of warmth and comfort: the glowing stove, the festive roast, the shimmering Christmas tree whose candles rose into the midnight sky as stars.

When the final blaze illuminated her loving grandmother's face, the child surrendered herself to that tender embrace. Released from the cold and starvation of mortal neglect, her pure spirit ascended into the golden dawn of eternal peace, leaving a smile of holy victory upon her sleeping lips.
moral: In the darkest freeze of human indifference, divine mercy shines as an everlasting light.
